circiter

adverb, with numbers and times; also a preposition with the accusative

The plain word with a number or an hour. It stands before or after the numeral.

Other words

  • ferē (fermē) — nearly, about

    adverb, usually after the word it qualifies · also used · classical · Traupman 202; Traupman 267

    As in quattuor ferē hōrārum.

  • ad + acc. — up to, about (a number)

    also used · classical

    With a numeral: ad ducentōs, some two hundred.

Examples

  • diēbus circiter quīndecim ad fīnēs Belgārum pervenit

    in about fifteen days he reached the territory of the BelgaeCaes. B.G. 2.2 (Lewis & Short)

  • Haec ferē dīxit.

    He said something like this.Traupman 102

See also estimate, almost, about.
